mcqs.question: In the context of AI applications in healthcare, what can AI forecast in Kenya up to six months ahead?
mcqs.explanation: AI can forecast child malnutrition in Kenya up to six months ahead. Oncology drug discovery is associated with IBM Watson and Exscientia, not the stated forecasting application.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding INS Ikshak is incorrect?
options: It was commissioned at Kochi by CNS Admiral Dinesh K. Tripathi on 6 November 2025.
It was built by GRSE, Kolkata, with more than 80% indigenous content.
It was the first SVL-class ship with dedicated accommodation for women.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that INS Ikshak means “The Navigator”; its name means “The Guide.” The other statements correctly describe its commissioning, indigenous content and dedicated accommodation for women.

mcqs.question:
Match the items in List-I with the corresponding descriptions in List-II.

List-I
(a) DRR Rice 100 (Kamala)
(b) Pusa DST Rice 1
(c) CRISPR-Cas9
(d) Bt Cotton

List-II
(i) GM example
(ii) Developed by ICAR-IIRR, Hyderabad
(iii) Gene-editing technology
(iv) Developed by ICAR-IARI, New Delhi
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-iv, c-iii and d-i. DRR Rice 100 (Kamala) was developed by ICAR-IIRR, Pusa DST Rice 1 by ICAR-IARI, CRISPR-Cas9 is the gene-editing technology, and Bt Cotton is a GM example.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the scrutiny of gene-edited rice varieties, consider the following statements:

1. Pusa DST Rice 1 had equal or lower yield in 12 of 20 sites.
2. Kamala underperformed in 8 of 19 sites.
3. Kamala flowered in 104 days, compared with 101 days for the comparison variety.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: Pusa DST Rice 1 had equal or lower yield in 12 of 20 sites, while Kamala underperformed in 8 of 19 sites. Statement 3 reverses the flowering figures; Kamala flowered in 101 days compared with 104 days for the comparison variety.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:

Statement A: The Ministry of Education will introduce AI in the curriculum from Class 3 in the academic year 2026–27.
Statement B: This follows the July 2025 ‘Skilling for AI Readiness’ initiative, under which CBSE schools offer AI as a skill subject from Class 6.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. AI is to enter the curriculum from Class 3 in 2026–27, while the earlier ‘Skilling for AI Readiness’ initiative enabled CBSE schools to offer AI as a skill subject from Class 6.
